text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the 4th corner!
With the roar of the crowd thundering, they enter the straightaway!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I'm gonna win...! I'll definitely! Win!!!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll finish this...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaaaagh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye surges forward all at once!!
Almond Eye takes the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (No way...! I won't give it up...! Not this Shuka Sho...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I absolutely will...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye takes the lead!! So strong! Almond Eye!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Wait up--

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye crosses the finish line!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa... gh...
Ha... wheeze...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (They got me...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (The place I fought tooth and nail to reach... Ai-san effortlessly surpassed it today...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ..................I really can't beat that.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: âLala!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ai-san...—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Please let me thank you.
Thank you so much for giving it your all against me today.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It was a race truly worthy of concluding the Triple Tiara.
I'm so very glad I was able to defeat you here.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I'm looking forward to the next race.
I won't lose there, either!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (What the heck is that――)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ain't that enough already...?
You won today...!
Isn't that good enough...?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (And yet you're already looking to the next one... Just what is it you're trying to beat...?!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...? Lala?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...The next race, huh?
I'll... look forward to it too, then.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Even though she's right in front of me...
Ai-san feels so far away...——)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I went to greet Lucky Lilac after her valiant effort
in the Shuka Sho, but she was visibly exhausted
both in body and mind...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I am deeply sorry.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, I... never could...
win this Shuka Sho..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've watched Lucky Lilac's hard work
and perseverance closer than anyone else.
I believed in her victory more than anyone in the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's why it's so frustrating.
That I couldn't lead her to victory.
That I made her apologize to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how formidable her rivals become,
Lucky Lilac will surely be able to win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is an Umamusume who can endure and bloom.
As her Trainer, I will keep believing in her and
supporting her. I'm fully prepared to do so.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
From here on out once more...
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Was I... able to give a proper smile just now...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days after the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
S-So you're really running
in the Japan Cup for your next race, then!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Aiming to become the strongest of the era,
I plan to dive right in!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: The Senior Class members who have declared their entry are an exceptionally prestigious and formidable lineup. What are your thoughts on this?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"No matter who my opponent is, I will win.
That feeling hasn't changed from the very beginning."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I will win the Japan Cup against an amazing field and prove that I am the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh...!!)

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "‘This announcement from Almond Eye quickly spread among race fans, pushing anticipation for the Japan Cup to its absolute peak—’"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: What should we do about the "Japan Cup"?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list: I thought you might want a rematch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Japan Cup presents an early opportunity for revenge.
However—
choice_data_list: If you want to run, it'll require some tough conditioning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Lucky Lilac was
far more exhausted from the recent 'Shuka Sho'
than we had imagined."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entering a grueling race like the Japan Cup,
where so many powerhouses gather,
means risks are unavoidable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, what matters most
is how Lucky Lilac feels."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If she wishes to run, then as her Trainer, it's my duty to do everything in my power to make that wish come true.
choice_data_list: Could you share your thoughts with me?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...I think I will pass on it.
The Japan Cup, that is.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Just as you said, Trainer, I still have lingering fatigue from the Shuka Sho, and on top of that—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
…………There will surely be more chances
for me to get my revenge against Ai-san
in the future, after all.
choice_data_list: Okay, then let's pick a different goal race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As of right now, a prime candidate for our target race is the Nakayama Kinen—a 1800m turf GII held at Nakayama Racecourse next February.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's a traditional race where Senior Class Umamusume often run to test their mettle with an eye on the big races from spring onwards.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"The Nakayama Kinen, huh?
...Sounds good. By that time, everything should be fully back in top shape."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's aim for the Nakayama Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, it was decided to kick off the Senior Class
with the Nakayama Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (This is no good...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(When I decided not to run in the Japan Cup today...
Back then, I...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I felt relieved from the bottom of my heart... that I didn't have to race against Ai-san.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That is sooo lame~~~~............

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(It's stuck in my head...
Losing to Ai-san at the Shuka Sho
and getting left completely in the dust, that feeling—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: …………I can't picture it at all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Seeing myself bloom—
